_doc: FIFTH HELD-OUT real project (Phase 4): uC/OS-II (samples/realworld/uC-OS2, ~15K lines; RTOS kernel by Weston Embedded/Micrium, trimmed as a real project would be to the kernel, the os_cfg.h template and ONE port: Win32/Visual Studio, i.e. Windows/MSVC-style code). ucos_ii.c #includes every kernel .c file (single-translation-unit build). Questions written from facts verified in the source AFTER all Phase 4 re-ranking work and BEFORE Verity was ever run on it. First runs (keyword-only, +embeddings, +local-model re-ranking) kept in bench/results/realworld_heldout5/first-run-*.

cases.q: What happens when a message is posted to a queue that is already full?

What happens when OSSemPend is called from an ISR?
What happens when a task waits for a mutex that a lower-priority task owns?
Where is the system time OSTime incremented?
How is the CPU usage percentage computed?
